The Defective Detective — Album 1: Serah the Kitsune

Procedural Nonsense

"pro-see-jerr-ull nonsense Stamped and filed"

[Verse 1]

Bell on the door, barely made a sound Little green shoes, eyes to the ground Too small for the chair, too tired to cry Clutching some papers stamped DENIED

Said, “Miss Serah, I don’t have much.” Empty little pockets, nervous little shrug “I saw your sign, I thought maybe you…” He stopped halfway like hope might cost him too

[Pre-Chorus]

Police sent him somewhere else Somewhere else sent him away Three desks, six forms, four waiting rooms And nobody listened to what he had to say

[Chorus]

pro-see-jerr-ull nonsense Stamped and filed Tell me since when did a category erase a child? Orange on paper So nobody cares Missing is missing I don’t care what color they wear

pro-see-jerr-ull nonsense Policy excuse A family disappears and somehow that’s not your use? You can quote your scope You can hide behind a line But somebody’s missing

And now they’re mine

[Verse 2]

Father died ten years ago Sickness took him, money went slow Just his mother, brother, him Three against a world already looking grim

He left that morning looking for work Maybe food, maybe anything first Came back home when the daylight died Door unlocked

Nobody inside

He waited till morning Then waited some more Went to every agency with an official door They saw Category Orange beside his name And suddenly his grief became somebody else’s game

[Pre-Chorus]

“They’re outside our operational scope” “That classification limits aid” Funny how a sentence gets longer When someone wants compassion delayed

[Chorus]

pro-see-jerr-ull nonsense Stamped and filed Tell me since when did a category erase a child? Orange on paper So nobody cares Missing is missing I don’t care what color they wear

pro-see-jerr-ull nonsense Policy excuse A family disappears and somehow that’s not your use? You can quote your scope You can hide behind a line But somebody’s missing

And now they’re mine

[Bridge]

I should say no

God, I should say no

Rent’s overdue and the power bill knows The phone finally rings and of course it’s free Apparently justice has terrible timing for me

He says, “I can clean” “I can carry” “I can work every day” “I don’t need money” “Just help me, okay?”

…

Dammit.

[Acoustic Guitar and Piano Solo]

No deposit. No retainer. No billable time.

One missing mother. One missing brother.

One broke detective losing her mind.

I rubbed my eyes.

Looked at the kid.

Looked at the bills.

…

“Fine.”

[Pre-Chorus]

But you work for me And you eat when I eat And if I catch you calling me “ma’am” We’re gonna have words in the street

Grab those papers Start from the start Tell me everything Every smell, every sound, every part

[Chorus]

pro-see-jerr-ull nonsense Stamped and filed Tell me since when did a category erase a child? Orange on paper So nobody cares Missing is missing I don’t care what color they wear

pro-see-jerr-ull nonsense Policy excuse A family disappears and somehow that’s not your use? You can quote your scope You can hide behind a line But somebody’s missing

And now they’re mine

[Final Chorus]

pro-see-jerr-ull nonsense Let them choke On every rule they wrote to keep the powerless broke Platinum, Gold Silver and more Funny how compassion gets measured at the door

Orange today Who knows tomorrow? How many colors does it take to classify sorrow?

They can keep their forms Their desks Their grand design

This case is open

And this kid is mine

[Outro]

First client.

Zero money.

Missing family.

Category Orange.

Great.

I opened my own office for freedom.

Apparently freedom comes with unpaid interns.

…

“Kid?”

“Yeah?”

“Start talking.”
